name: Stagefright
tagline: A media parser in Android that a message can reach.
blurb: Stagefright, the library Android used to open video, could be crashed or worse by a crafted file. The ugly path in was MMS: the phone parsed the message before anyone pressed play.

nvd.description: Integer overflow in the SampleTable::setSampleToChunkParams function in SampleTable.cpp in libstagefright in Android before 5.1.1 LMY48I allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted atoms in MP4 data that trigger an unchecked multiplication, aka internal bug 20139950, a related issue to CVE-2015-4496.
